{{Top}}
A '''Headmaster''' was the head of a school or academy. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]] was headmaster of the combined [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academies]], and was succeeded by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Trachta]] after the former was executed for his failed [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]]. Ironically, Trachta would later attempt his own [[Anti-Sith conspiracy|coup]].
